name: Merging-unit binary status publisher
summary: Publishes the defined primary-equipment status information from the merging unit.
description: Publishes the defined primary-equipment status information from the merging unit. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Equipment status inputs” at the input and “Digital status messages” at the output. Status and sampled measurements use different data roles.
